Featuring fully glazed double doors that open out onto a sheltered veranda, this summerhouse offers an ideal spot for enjoying the summer weather while being protected from the sun. The open interior offers plenty of room for large furniture and storage. Featuring four large styrene glazed windows, this garden building floods with light and air to create a bright and welcoming space. The modular construction of this summerhouse allows you to place the windows on either side, allowing you to adapt the building to suit your garden. Designed with Georgian bars and antique style hinges and fixtures, this summerhouse offers a traditional and stylish look. Manufactured using 12mm Shiplap, also known as tongue & groove, the walls of this garden room are designed to keep water and draughts firmly at bay, while providing a robust and long lasting construction. Thick wooden framing provides support for the panels to attach to; this creates a solid structure that can comfortably withstand the British weather conditions. Hard wearing tongue and groove boards construct the roof and the floor of this building which offer a premium and heavy duty finish. The roof is covered with high quality mineral roofing felt which will give your building further protection from the elements. A lock and key are supplied as standard to keep your building and belongings securely locked away. Manufactured here in the UK, using responsibly sourced timber.

name: William Morris At Home Strawberry Thief Deep Blue Wallpaper - Sample
description: This is an A4 Sized Sample. Perhaps William Morris’s most recognisable design, Strawberry Thief was inspired by the thrushes that crept under Morris’s strawberry nets in his garden at Kelmscott Manor, Oxfordshire. The original pattern took several days to print using hand-carved woodblocks to build up the different colours, and ‘Strawberry Thief’ was consequently one of Morris’s firm’s most expensive cottons. Whilst waiting to see the first piece printed, Morris endured sleepless nights in his lodgings at Merton Abbey. Designed in 1883, Strawberry Thief remains one of William Morris’s most popular and iconic designs. Strawberry Thief Deep Blue provides a depth of rich colour featuring hues of muted red, teal and dark blue, partnered with pops of lighter tones to accentuate the detail within the design. Featuring both a charcoal and smoker BBQ, you can heat up various succulent meats and vegetables for great cooking versatility. The included temperature gauge and airflow vent let you monitor and take control of the heat, ensuring meat is grilled accurately for delicious results. A high-grade heat resistant steel body provides the added protection needed when grilling at intense temperatures, ensuring long lasting durability, whilst cool touch Bakelite handles offer comfort and additional safety when using the BBQ. Two doors on the front of the grill provide easy access, making it simple to add coal when needed, whilst the lid can be removed for convenience or utilised when cooking, locking in heat to provide consistent cooking results. Safe and sturdy splayed feet offer stability when cooking.

name: William Morris At Home Pimpernel Blue Wallpaper - 10m x 52cm
description: This hand block printed design, Pimpernel Blue, bursts with colour and life, featuring large, sensual tulips and their curling leaves entwined with foliage and small pimpernel flowers. It showcases William Morris's humour, as the dominating tulips contrast with the design's namesake, the secondary Pimpernel flower. The almost symmetrical layout adorned Kelmscott Manor, Morris’s summer home, and an original hand block printed length exists in The Gallery’s archive. Rich blue and teal tones dress the vines, strikingly contrasted with beautiful gold floral pimpernels. This showstopping matt finish wallpaper invites intrigue and allure, making it the perfect choice for a bold feature wall.

name: Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless Brushless 76mm Cut-Off Grinder - Bare
description: Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless Brushless 76mm Cut-Off Grinder is a real all-rounder for demanding trade workers. The small and light tool separates metal, tiles and stone quicker and easier than many other larger angle grinders. It can be utilised with cutting discs with a diameter of 76mm and the cutting depth can be adjusted without tools for material-specific work up to maximum 16mm. To adapt to any working position, the rotatable cutting disc guard can be subsequently adjusted quickly and without additional tools. Maximum safety in use is ensured by the restart protection and the motor brake, which ensures the cutting disc comes to a quick stop. To exchange the cutting disc, a hexagon socket wrench for the spindle lock is stowed directly on the device. The Einhell Professional cordless cut-off tool is supplied with a diamond cutting disc for tiles and three thin cutting discs for metal. Supplied without battery and charger, available separately 2.5Ah battery and fast charger kit (product code 257481).

name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 35/35 (70mm) - Nickel
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.
breadcrumb_str: Home > Products > Hardware & Security > Door Locks & Latches > Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 35/35 (70mm) - Nickel

The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.

name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 45/35 (80mm) - Nickel
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.

name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 40/40 (80mm) - Brass
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.
breadcrumb_str: Home > Products > Hardware & Security > Door Locks & Latches > Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 40/40 (80mm) - Brass

name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 40/40 (80mm) - Nickel
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.

name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 45/50 (95mm) - Matt Black
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.

This helps optimise power consumption, only using the energy needed to heat the pan itself. With Multizone operation the cooking zones can be used as two independent cooking zones or combined into a single zone. Each zone automatically adapts to the size and position of the dishes and is heated only where the pans are set down, providing better heat distribution. Each zone features a slider control panel which allows the user to adjust the heat level by simply running a finger across the touch surface. Auto-Vent 2.0 allows the hob to issue commands to a connected Smeg cooker hood. The cooker hood will automatically adjust its extraction speed to match the hob settings and pan temperature. Auto-Vent 2.0 can only be used when combined with a Smeg Auto-Vent 2.0 hood.

name: Smeg SIM3964N 90cm Induction Auto-Vent 2.0 Hob - Matte Black
description: Induction allows for precise temperature control when cooking or simmering. Heat is only generated when the pan comes into direct contact with the specific cooking zone, ensuring safety in the presence of children. This helps optimise power consumption, only using the energy needed to heat the pan itself. With Multizone operation the cooking zones can be used as two independent cooking zones or combined into a single zone. Each zone automatically adapts to the size and position of the dishes and is heated only where the pans are set down, providing better heat distribution. Auto-Vent 2.0 can only be used when combined with a Smeg Auto-Vent 2.0 hood. Other features include permanent auto pot detection, auto bridge function and grill function.

description: Combining the elegance of traditional styling with the precision and technology of modern day design & accurate flow control, the Bayswater Grand Riser Mixer Shower Kit has thermostatic control to +/- 1 degree - even if the water pressure fluctuates. name: SmartSeal ClimaShield Slate Grey Roof Coating - 20L
description: Climashield Roof Coating is used to renew the look of ageing, porous concrete roof tiles. Superior to a roof paint, it will transform the look of old concrete roof tiles and acts as a waterproof roof paint sealer as well as a coloured roof coating. Once applied, the waterproof roof paint or roof paint sealer will aesthetically transform the roof, leave it water resistant and protect it from the harmful effects of UV light. The roof coating will also allow 'flexing' and movement within the roof tile. Technically this is highly important because exposure to heat and cold will cause roof tiles to expand and contract. ***SUITABLE FOR CONCRETE ROOF TILES ONLY***

name: SmartSeal ClimaShield Anthracite Roof Coating - 20L
description: Climashield Roof Coating is used to renew the look of ageing, porous concrete roof tiles. Superior to a roof paint, it will transform the look of old concrete roof tiles and acts as a waterproof roof paint sealer as well as a coloured roof coating. Once applied, the waterproof roof paint or roof paint sealer will aesthetically transform the roof, leave it water resistant and protect it from the harmful effects of UV light. The roof coating will also allow 'flexing' and movement within the roof tile. Technically this is highly important because exposure to heat and cold will cause roof tiles to expand and contract. ***SUITABLE FOR CONCRETE ROOF TILES ONLY***
breadcrumb_str: Home > Products > Building Supplies & Materials > Roofing > Roof Repair Liquids > SmartSeal ClimaShield Anthracite Roof Coating - 20L

name: Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless 27L Coolbox - Bare
description: Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless 27L Coolbox is ideal on the go, whether on excursions or at the construction site. It comes with a 230V and a 12V cable and automatically selects the operating mode depending on the existing power source. This way, it can be pre-cooled at home using a socket and then cooled on the go using the cigarette lighter socket of your car. For 12V operation, the cooling box is equipped with a vehicle battery protection that prevents any deep discharge of your battery. Afterwards, contents can be kept cool using the battery. The cooling box has a volume of 27 litres and can therefore hold 36 cans (of 0.33L each), 20 bottles (of 0.5 L each) or 6 large 1.5L bottles. A flexible divider is supplied to divide the cold room, and there is also a bottle opener integrated into the housing. In addition, the box is equipped with a large pocket for accessories, a side pocket with a battery holder and a side pocket for a replaceable battery to extend the running time. A battery charge indicator is integrated directly into the device and the cooling or heating functions can be selected via a central switch. Using the rotary switch, the cooling capacity can be set infinitely up to 20°C below the respective ambient temperature. The keep-warm function can be adjusted to max. 60°C. For easy transportation, the cooling box comes with an adjustable carrying strap with shoulder pad and a large carrying handle, which can also keep the lid of the cooling box open if necessary. Battery and fast charger kit are sold separately (product code 257481).
breadcrumb: Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless 27L Coolbox - Bare

name: AVA PL7 Pressure Washer Telescopic Lance
description: AVA Telescopic Lance is over four meters when fully extended and has an adjustable head angle. It is suitable for work in heights up to five meters, such as a large house or vehicle. It can also be used to apply detergent with the use of an AVA Foam Cannon. When using the lance to apply detergent, you have the choice of using the foam cannon with the bottle attached or make use of the telescopic lances built-in adjustable detergent system for convenience. The telescopic lance utilises a standard AVA bayonet at the top, which allows you to mount every nozzle, brush or patio cleaner from AVA's extensive range of equipment. This lance has AVA's new zero-force trigger system that reduces the holding force in the trigger by approximately 90% compared to their old AVA gun. A shoulder strap is included to distribute the weight of the lance and is highly recommended for prolonged use. The AVA Telescopic Lance is compatible with all AVA pressure washers, most newer Kärcher (with use of the included adapter), Nilfisk, Bosch, Stihl, Husqvarna and Makita.
breadcrumb: AVA PL7 Pressure Washer Telescopic Lance

name: SmartSeal Brick Sealer - 10L
description: Smartseal Brick Sealer is a professional-grade, solvent-free, breathable, clear, impregnating coating system. Once applied, the brick sealer alters the chemical structure of the hard surface. This provides an excellent water repellent and stain resistant barrier which is suited for bricks, masonry and facades. Furthermore, it protects against water ingress into brickwork and soiling. Areas with Smartseal impregnating brick sealer applied will stay cleaner and drier, lessening deterioration and subsidising future cleaning expenses. For optimum results, apply generously to allow a complete saturation. On the majority of brickwork, average coverage is around 5m² per litre. For stonework & specialist bricks, coverage up to 10m² per litre can be seen on average.

name: Einhell Power X-Change 18V 5.2Ah Battery & Charger Kit
description: Einhell Power X-Change 18V 5.2Ah Battery & Charger Kit provides power and endurance to all cordless tools across the entire product family. The high-quality Li-ion battery resists the memory effect and the self-discharge which usually occurs in batteries for constant, high power. The 5.2Ah battery is also suitable for powerful twin pack utilisation in 36V applications. The process-controlled Active Battery Management System (ABS) continuously monitors the battery parameters using its integrated microprocessor. This ensures maximum safety, optimal device performance, maximum runtime and maximum service life. You can check the current charge status via the 3-setting LED indicator. The design of the housing makes it resistant to dust, corrosion and mechanical influences. The rubber coating gives the battery high impact protection and ensures a good grip. Thanks to the recessed grip, the battery can be easily removed from all units. The 3A charging device has a compact design and therefore requires little space and due to the integrated hanging eyelets, it can easily be assembled on the wall. The fast charging technology makes charging times even shorter, and the battery is constantly monitored by the smart charging management system for optimal charging and top safety. Thanks to the refresh mode, it is possible to reactivate deeply discharged batteries. All current information for the battery is provided via a 6-fold LED status indicator for each battery. The 5.2Ah battery is ready for use in just 100 minutes. If the battery stays in the charging device for longer, then it is gently charged to 100%.
breadcrumb: Einhell Power X-Change 18V 5.2Ah Battery & Charger Kit

name: Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless Brushless Angle Grinder 115mm - Bare
description: The Einhell Power X-Change 18V Cordless Brushless 115mm Angle Grinder is a powerful and comfortable helper for work in the workshop, home and garage. Optimal results up to a cutting depth of 28mm can be achieved with a Ø 115 mm cutting disc and a 2.5Ah battery. The device is powered by the Einhell PurePOWER Brushless motor which offers more power and a longer running time than conventional carbon brush motors. Two integrated dust screens protect the interior of the angle grinder from dirt and in combination with the intelligent air ducting, increase the service life. The grilles can be removed for easy cleaning. With an idle speed of 8,500rpm, even demanding roughing and cutting work can be done. The soft start function and the restart protection protect the motor and are used for user safety. The compact and lightweight design with additional handle, which can be assembled in 2 positions, makes it pleasant to work with. The decoupling of the motor and transmission ensures a high level of smoothness, while the disc protection with quick adjustment enables flexible working. Cut-off guard is also included. The cordless angle grinder is equipped with an overload protection that, together with a robust aluminium gearbox housing, ensures the longevity of the device. Battery and fast charger kit are sold separately (product code 257481).

name: Bosch Professional GDR 18V-215 Cordless Brushless Impact Driver - Bare
description: The Bosch Professional GDR 18V-215 Cordless Brushless Impact Driver swiftly drives screws through wood or metal at 3,300rpm. With a torque of 215Nm, it easily handles screwdriving into hard wood and is ideal for hard to access tight spaces thanks to its compact design. It has 2 auto driving modes for metal and wood for screws with a head length of 121mm (or 126mm, depending on the selected model). It can also stop automatically or slow down when it reaches the surface of your material, so you get a good quality finishing. The GDR 18V-215 Professional is ideal for wood and metal based materials. If you are working with wood, it easily drives 50mm screws and long screws of 80-140mm into wood frames. It also drives self driving screws into sheet metal of 3mm, M8 machine screw into pre-threaded metal blocks, self-tapping screws into sheet metal of less than 3mm. Battery and Charger supplied separately.

name: Ottimo 465 Dual Fuel 2-Burner BBQ
description: The ottimo 465 Dual Fuel 2-Burner BBQ is designed for versatile outdoor cooking, perfect for feeding 3-5 people with ease. Whether you're hosting a quick family dinner or a weekend garden party, this hybrid station adapts to your needs, use gas for convenience, charcoal for authentic smoky flavour, or both simultaneously for maximum cooking flexibility. Engineered with two main gas burners and an additional side burner, this dual fuel grill offers exceptional cooking versatility across two generous cooking zones (40 x 37.5cm each). The gas side features two powerful burners with precise temperature control, whilst the charcoal side delivers authentic BBQ flavour, allowing you to grill steaks on gas whilst smoking ribs over charcoal at the same time. Built with durable steel and stainless steel burners, it features two enamelled flame tamers with 800°C heat resistance on the gas side, ensuring even heat distribution and protecting burners from grease. The built-in thermometer allows temperature monitoring across both zones, whilst the warming rack keeps food ready to serve. Practical side table provides prep space for spices and food, whilst the side burner adds extra cooking capability for sauces or side dishes. The thoughtful design includes separate oil drip tray and ash tray for easier maintenance, keeping gas and charcoal cleaning completely independent. Expertly engineered wheels ensure easy repositioning around your patio or garden, whilst two front doors reveal spacious cabinet storage for gas bottles, charcoal bags, and BBQ accessories when not in use. A gas regulator and hose are included for easy connection to standard gas bottles. Ideal for: Gardens, patios, BBQ enthusiasts, versatile cooking, and outdoor entertaining.

description: The Einhell cordless scarifier fan GE-SA 36/35 Li-Solo ensures impeccable greenery in your home garden. description: The Tristar Mobile Air Cooler 4L uses cold water to cool the airflow so you can enjoy a refreshing breeze a few degrees lower than the ambient temperature. The air cooler is portable because of its sturdy castors, just fill the reservoir up with water and plug it in. The Tristar air cooler uses cold water to cool the airflow so it does not become dry like when using an air-conditioner. This way you will suffer less from dry eyes or a dry throat. An air cooler is much more suitable for people suffering from respiratory problems exacerbated by dry air. Air-coolers blow out cooler air than they draw in but they will not reduce the ambient temperature of a closed space. For whole room cooling, consider an an air-conditioner.

name: EVO-STIK Flexibond Tile Adhesive Primer White - 1L
description: EVO-STIK Flexibond Primer is an acrylic dispersion polymer. It can be used as a flexible admixture with cement-based tile adhesives and floor grouts, and as a tile adhesive primer or sealer for ready-mixed tile adhesives and floor underlayment screeds. When added to tile adhesive, this adhesive primer improves flexibility as well as shear and tensile strength, giving greater resistance to minor movements and vibration. It also enhances adhesion for direct fixing to glazed tiles or other impervious surfaces. EVO-STIK Flexibond tile adhesive primer works by part filling the cement pores in the tile adhesive, reducing the permeability and therefore reducing any damage by liquid transfer. It also improves the deformability of C2 adhesives to meet the requirements of class S1 according to EN12022. For adding to cement-based tile adhesives and floor grouts, or for use as a primer or sealer for ready-mixed tile adhesives and floor underlayment screeds. Available as a 1L tile adhesive primer.

A suction inlet sealing cap also prevents accidental entry or release of hazardous dust from the machine when not in use, or during transport.
